data.name: Subhash
data.gender_notes: Subhash is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bringer of Good News. The name Subhash carries the meaning “Good News” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Subhash usually hope their child will grow to embody good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who spreads good news and brings happiness
data.etymology: Subhash belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good News.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Subhash total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_sanskrit.name: सुभाष
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सु (su) - Good, भाष (bhāṣ) - Speech, News, Word, Announcement. So, सुभाष (subhāṣ) means 'Good News' or 'Auspicious'.

in_hindi.name: सुभाष
in_hindi.meaning: शुभ (śubh) - Good, वाच (vāc) - Speech. So, सुभाष (subhāṣ) means 'Good Speech' or 'Auspicious Words'.

in_tamil.name: சுபகச்சி
in_tamil.meaning: சு (cu) - Good, பகச்சி (pakacci) - Auspicious, Fortunate. So, சுபகச்சி (subhakacci) means 'Good and Auspicious' or 'Fortunate'.

in_telugu.name: శుభశ
in_telugu.meaning: శు (śu) - Good, శ (śa) - Birth, Origin. So, శుభశ (śubhaśa) means 'Good Origin' or 'Good Birth'.

in_marathi.name: Subhash
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subhash हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bringer of Good News

in_bengali.name: Subhash
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Good News
in_bengali.long_meaning: Subhash একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bringer of Good News

data.cultural_impact: The name "Subhash" in Hindu culture is widely believed to be auspicious and brings good news or good tidings. This name is popular in India and is given to boys, signifying the hope and expectation of a positive future. Subhash also signifies intelligence and inner wisdom.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Subhash" represents the inner voice of guidance and wisdom that helps us navigate our lives. It is believed that the divine or the inner self is constantly sending us messages and guidance, and the name "Subhash" serves as a reminder to listen and follow the inner voice for spiritual growth and enlightenment. It is also believed that Subhash is a representation of the divine power that brings joy, peace, and prosperity into our lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Subhash signifies the one who brings good news or auspicious beginnings. It is a representation of positive and optimistic outlook towards life.

vedic_reference.note: Subhash is not a directly derived name from the Vedas or Indian Mythology.

historical_references.reference: Subhash Chandra Bose was a prominent Indian nationalist leader who sought to free India from British rule during World War II.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Subhash is of Indian origin and has historical significance as the name of a prominent Indian nationalist leader. It is also used as a common name in modern times. In social media and personal use, the name Subhash is often used without any specific historical or cultural context.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Lakshmi Subhash in Kolkata, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Subhash, which means "Good News". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
